skill.name: constitutional-writer
skill.description: Extracts mission, values, vision, governance, decision processes, and quality standards from source documents, then formats them into a project constitution.
skill.summary: Creates structured project constitutions from charters, plans, handbooks, and other source documents.

content.value_statement: Teams often hide mission, values, and governance rules across scattered documents. This skill extracts those elements and turns them into a clear project constitution.
actual_capabilities: Identifies mission, purpose, vision, values, governance, decisions, and quality standards in source documents.
Tags extracted content with labels such as MISSION, VALUES, VISION, GOVERNANCE, and STANDARDS.
Formats extracted material into a constitution with standard sections and concise bullets.
Uses a reference guide for common constitutional patterns across charters, plans, policies, and handbooks.
Includes a Python text extractor that reads an input file and prints a formatted constitution.
limitations: It depends on source documents and should not invent missing mission or governance details.
The included Python script reads text files; PDF and DOCX handling requires separate tools or skills.
It does not provide legal review, compliance advice, or enforceable governance policy.
Implicit cultural norms may be missed when they are not stated in the source material.

use_cases.title: Convert a Project Charter
use_cases.description: Turn an existing charter into a clean constitution with mission, vision, values, governance, and quality standards.

use_cases.title: Consolidate Team Principles
use_cases.description: Extract shared values and decision rules from planning notes, handbooks, and policy documents.

use_cases.title: Standardize Documentation
use_cases.description: Create consistent constitution drafts for multiple projects using the same section structure.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a Basic Constitution
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request using one source document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the attached project charter and extract a project constitution. Include mission, vision, values, governance, and quality standards.

prompt_templates.title: Use Exact Source Language
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that needs faithful wording.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a constitution from this document. Use exact wording where possible and do not add principles that are not present.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Multiple Sources
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with overlapping source material.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these planning, policy, and culture documents. Consolidate duplicate statements and produce one unified project constitution.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Section Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that checks completeness before drafting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these documents for constitutional content. Draft the constitution and list any missing sections that lack source evidence.

output_examples.input: A project charter with mission, values, decision rules, and quality targets.
output_examples.output: A constitution draft with sections for Mission and Purpose, Vision, Core Values, Governance, Decision Making, and Quality Standards.

output_examples.input: Several team documents with repeated statements about ownership, accountability, and collaboration.
output_examples.output: A consolidated constitution that removes duplicate ideas and keeps the strongest source-backed wording.

output_examples.input: A handbook that describes team culture but has no explicit mission section.
output_examples.output: A constitution draft that captures cultural commitments and leaves the missing mission section clearly unsupported.

best_practices: Provide source documents with clear headings, dates, and project names.
Ask the skill to preserve exact wording for important commitments.
Review the final constitution with stakeholders before adoption.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent values, authority rules, or success metrics without source evidence.
Do not use the draft as legal or compliance guidance without expert review.
Do not mix unrelated projects in one request unless you want one combined constitution.

faq.question: What documents work best with this skill?
faq.answer: Project charters, strategic plans, policy documents, handbooks, and planning notes work well when they include mission or governance content.

faq.question: Can it process PDF or DOCX files?
faq.answer: The skill can guide PDF or DOCX processing through other tools. The included Python script only reads text files.

faq.question: Will it create missing constitutional sections?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to extract and format source-backed content, not invent missing principles or rules.

faq.question: Can it merge several documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It can consolidate overlapping mission, values, governance, and standards content into one constitution.

faq.question: Is the output legally binding?
faq.answer: No. The output is a documentation draft and should be reviewed before formal adoption.

faq.question: Which AI tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
